text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Hello, Nanny? I've a special favor to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Apparently, my favorite brand of skin toner has been discontinued…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I've tried using a substitute, but it's made my skin red and tingly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Even minor rashes should be taken seriously. …Left unattended, a torn seam will end up a gaping hole.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan seems concerned about her skin irritation…
